Overview

Sylhet is a city in Sylhet with a population of 700,000. A picturesque city in northeastern Bangladesh known for its tea gardens, rolling hills, and large diaspora community. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
